messages:
Noah (Sales): quick handoff for Solstice Labs pilot — 30d trial starts today. Key asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering (customer CIDR 10.40.0.0/16), and reserved throughput for scheduled load tests (~350 rps peak). Billing contact is accounting@solsticelabs.com.
Elena (CS): added to Gainsight, setting 30/45/55d touchpoints. We should collect API error rate, median and 95p latency during week-1.
Ravi (Support): I9ll open a ticket and tag infra. Please paste the SAML metadata and any certificate details.
Noah (Sales): SAML metadata sent via secure email to Elena. No custom models — customer expects hosted parity. They provided three system prompt templates for triage flows.
Tess (Eng): noted. Questions: 1) OK to run quantized-2 variant for cost during pilot? 2) Do we need an allowlist of egress domains?
Elena (CS): quantized-2 is OK for pilot. Customer egress needs only our regions and their monitoring endpoints; they asked for strict egress rules.
provision-bot: Ticket CS-5151 created by Ravi — "Solstice pilot: SAML + VPC peering + reserved throughput". Assignees: @tess_eng, @elena_cs. ETA for peering validation: 36h.
Tess (Eng): Eng action items: validate peering and run connectivity smoke tests, stage SAML in test IdP, allocate reserved slot and run a quick sanity generation. I9ll post the smoke test command and results.
Ravi (Support): added network checklist to CS-5151 and set priority: high. Please include traces for >400ms calls.
Clara (Success Manager): I9ll prepare a short week-1 feedback survey and track responses in the health dashboard. Current renewal risk: watch (depends on pilot perf and network setup).
Noah (Sales): looping in billing (accounting@solsticelabs.com) and scheduling week-1 demo for Tue 11am PT.
Elena (CS): owners recap: Tess — eng tasks; Ravi — support ticket & logs; Clara — health tracking and survey; Noah — customer comms. Next steps: Tess to confirm peering CIDR and smoke test output; Ravi to post ticket updates; Noah to confirm demo invite. Tag #eng-oncall for any blocking peering failures. Thanks all!
